text:
elin (Design): Heads up from today's UX pass — the metrics panel is confusing when series use different units (throughput vs latency). Users expect a clear axis unit and an inline marker when mixed. Thinking: add a tiny badge on a series that diverges from the primary axis (e.g., 'ms' badge) and a small explanation line above the chart.
rob (PM): +1. Also product asked for an option to switch the y-axis to log scale for long-tailed latency distributions. Should be opt-in, not default.
tay (Eng): We can add a per-panel control: linear | log. Implementation notes: log scale invalid for zeros/negatives; need to sanitize or show a warning. Performance is fine client-side using d3-scale-log for up to ~200 series.
morgan (Accessibility Bot): A11y: when toggling scales, announce the change with aria-live: "Y axis switched to log scale". For the unit-badges, ensure text is at least 4.5:1 contrast and the badge has an accessible name (e.g., "series unit: milliseconds").
elin (Design): Visual idea: small, rounded micro-badges (8px height) aligned to the legend swatch; on hover show "ms — different axis" tooltip. Keep primary axis label bold and larger, secondary units lighter.
samira (Research): From session tests: users missed spikes when smoothing was ON by default. Suggest smoothing be collapsed into a compact control: smoothing slider with preset buttons (Off / Soft / Strong). Off by default for ops dashboards.
tay (Eng): Ok for smoothing control. Quick config sketch for front-end state:
```
panelSettings: {
  axisScale: 'linear',
  smoothing: 'off',
  unitMode: 'auto' // auto | force-primary | split
}
```
If unitMode === 'split' show unit badges and a tiny legend note.
rob (PM): For copy, prefer short hints: "Different units shown — see badges" and tooltip: "This series is measured in milliseconds and uses a separate axis." Keep hint copy < 60 chars.
morgan (Accessibility Bot): Tooltip copy suggestion (screen-reader friendly): "Series unit: milliseconds. This series is plotted on a separate axis." Include keyboard focus target for the badge (tab stops).
elin (Design): Also accessibility visual: provide an optional high-contrast stroke for outliers called an "outlier sentinel" (thin dashed line overlay) so spikes are visible even when colors are similar. Toggleable and off by default.
tay (Eng): Implementation note for sentinel: compute local z-score and draw dashed overlay segments where z > 3. Config placeholder:
```
outlierSentinel: { enabled: false, threshold: 3 }
```
Will add to the chart renderer; cheap to compute on the client.
samira (Research): We should run a quick A/B with sentinel ON for 50 users to check false positives. Ops folks liked it in internal tests.
rob (PM): Action items: tay to prototype badges + log toggle + sentinel; elin to produce two mock variations (badge placement left vs inline); morgan to provide aria snippets; samira to schedule small usability check. Deadline: branch by Friday.
tay (Eng): I'll spin up a branch and tag you all. Quick question: default unitMode = 'auto'? I think yes, keep low noise.
elin (Design): auto is fine. If many unit types show up, start collapsed with a single "Mixed units" banner that expands to badge view.
morgan (Accessibility Bot): Reminder: document keyboard shortcuts for toggles and include focus order in design spec. Happy to review the branch for accessibility checks.
rob (PM): Thanks team. Ping this thread when the PR exists.
